im Instantly failing a settlement liberation, seeking advice
so im doing a playthrough where i liberate EVERY settlement. so far i wasent having that big of an issue, until i got to the middle of the game. im trying to liberate the military base on the coast of the Encarnacion province. whenever i start the mission, i either instantly fail before i can even move my character. Or i instantly fail the second i blow up the first road blockade. some times ill instantly fail as im trying to destroy the blockade. What gives? also why does the enemys tank fire rapidly like a machine gun, yet when i get in the tank i can only fire once every 5-10 seconds? am i failing because the enemy tanks kill a large amount of the rebels in a short span? is that why im instantly failing or is it a bug or something?
